top_signals.title: Japanese Bond Yields Fall as AI Jitters Spur Haven Demand
top_signals.summary: Japanese government bond yields fell across the curve on Friday as an AI-driven selloff in equities boosted demand for haven assets, with a rally in US Treasuries spilling over into the Japanese market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: SK Hynix shares slide after chipmaker scraps Solidigm IPO plans
top_signals.summary: SK Hynix has shelved plans for a potential U.S. IPO of Solidigm amid market volatility and share price concerns.

top_signals.title: Indian tech company eMudhra announces withdrawal from certificate business after security incident
top_signals.summary: The issue was publicized by cybersecurity researcher Scott Helme, who published a blog saying that instead of a random 384-bit number, one of the company's private keys was just the number four.
